source.variation: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes e in one stroke: from the middle left along the bar to the right, then anticlockwise up, over, down and round to the lower right. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of e, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. All 120 are one stroke; 90 start at the middle left, and all 120 turn anticlockwise. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans e bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer.

source.variation: The Grundschrift-App was made in a research project of the Laborschule at Bielefeld University with the Grundschulverband, on its Grundschrift school model, with a teacher advisory team. Each letter is an ordered list of paths, one per pen-down stroke, which the app makes a child trace in order. It writes i in two strokes: the stem first, from the top down, and the dot last. Grundschrift ends the stroke with a small hook to the right that Noto Sans does not print, so the path ends where the printed letter ends. UJIpenchars2 (Prat, Castro, Llorens, Marzal and Vilar; UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 177, CC BY 4.0) holds 120 tablet pen traces of i, two by each of 60 adult Spanish writers; only counts are cited. 115 of the 120 are two strokes, and in all 115 the dot, the shorter stroke, comes last. The app's repository has no licence, so only the order, the start, the direction and the lifts are taken from it; no point is copied, and the path is fitted to the Noto Sans i bundled in NotoSansDevanagari-Static.ttf. Handwriting varies by writer.
